headline: Power Backup Report for Harris County
summary: Homes in Harris County face a long outage about once every 5 years based on 8 years of records since 2018. In 2024, one storm left 91% of homes in the county without power. The longest-waiting tenth of homes waited about 175 hours. Another event hit 27% of homes in the county with about 140 hours for the longest-waiting tenth. One Core lasts about 15 hours in August. Two Cores last about 25 hours in August. Two Cores last about 42 hours in January. The suggested number of Cores is 2 Cores. Two Cores cover 42% of past 12-hour-plus outage hours. Base confirms sizing at install.
